description: Validate the BBS9 beta-propeller against the 4YD8 crystal structure, recompute per-partner contact residues in 6VBU, and transfer them through domain-wise structural superposition onto C. elegans BBS-9 (AF-O01514) to give exact worm residue numbers for curator verification
code:
import os, requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

OUT="/tmp/bbs9g"; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
AA3to1={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y',
'VAL':'V','MSE':'M','SEC':'U','PYL':'O'}
SUB={"0":"BBS18","1":"BBS1","2":"BBS2","3":"ARL6","4":"BBS4","5":"BBS5","7":"BBS7","8":"BBS8","9":"BBS9"}
def load(pid):
    f=f"{OUT}/{pid}.cif"
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        r=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",headers=H,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status()
        open(f,"w").write(r.text)
    cols=[];rows=[];reading=False
    for line in open(f):
        t=line.strip()
        if t.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(t.split(".")[1].split()[0]); continue
        if cols and not reading:
            if t.startswith("#") or t=="" or t.startswith("_") or t.startswith("loop_"): continue
            reading=True
        if reading:
            if t.startswith("#") or t=="": break
            pp=t.split()
            if len(pp)==len(cols): rows.append(pp)
    df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=cols); df=df[df["group_PDB"]=="ATOM"].copy()
    if "label_alt_id" in df: df=df[df["label_alt_id"].isin([".","A"])]
    for c in ["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]: df[c]=pd.to_numeric(df[c],errors="coerce")
    df["resnum"]=pd.to_numeric(df["auth_seq_id"],errors="coerce")
    df["chain"]=df["auth_asym_id"]; df["aa"]=df["label_comp_id"].map(AA3to1)
    df["atom"]=df["label_atom_id"].str.strip('"')
    return df.dropna(subset=["aa"]).reset_index(drop=True)

def ca(df,ch):
    g=df[(df.chain==ch)&(df.atom=="CA")].sort_values("resnum")
    return g["resnum"].to_numpy().astype(int),g["aa"].to_numpy(),g[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].to_numpy()

def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    R=U@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(U@Vt))])@Vt
    return R,qc-pc@R
def nw(S,gap=0.6):
    n,m=S.shape; NEG=-1e9; M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); M[0,:]=0.0; jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        base=np.full(m+1,NEG)
        base[1:]=np.maximum(M[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1,:],M[i-1,1:]-gap); base[0]=M[i-1,0]-gap
        M[i,:]=np.maximum.accumulate(base+gap*jj)-gap*jj
    i,j=n,m; pr=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(M[i,j]-(M[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-6: pr.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1;j-=1
        elif abs(M[i,j]-(M[i-1,j]-gap))<1e-6: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def tmalign(A,B,Lnorm=None):
    """A,B: CA coords. returns (TM, rmsd, pairs) using gapless-thread seeds + iterative NW/Kabsch"""
    L=Lnorm or min(len(A),len(B)); d0=max(1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8,1.0)
    best=(-1,None,None)
    seeds=[]
    for off in range(-len(B)+5,len(A)-4,max(1,(len(A)+len(B))//40)):
        p=[(i,i-off) for i in range(len(A)) if 0<=i-off<len(B)]
        if len(p)>=10: seeds.append(p)
    for pr in seeds:
        cur=pr
        for _ in range(12):
            P=A[[x[0] for x in cur]]; Q=B[[x[1] for x in cur]]
            if len(P)<4: break
            R,t=kabsch(P,Q); At=A@R+t
            D=np.linalg.norm(At[:,None,:]-B[None,:,:],axis=2)
            S=1.0/(1.0+(D/d0)**2)
            new=nw(S)
            if new==cur: break
            cur=new
        if len(cur)<4: continue
        P=A[[x[0] for x in cur]]; Q=B[[x[1] for x in cur]]
        R,t=kabsch(P,Q); At=A@R+t
        d=np.linalg.norm(At[[x[0] for x in cur]]-B[[x[1] for x in cur]],axis=1)
        tm=np.sum(1/(1+(d/d0)**2))/L
        if tm>best[0]: best=(tm,cur,(R,t,d))
    tm,cur,ex=best
    if cur is None: return 0.0,np.nan,[]
    d=ex[2]; keep=[c for c,dd in zip(cur,d) if dd<5.0]
    rms=float(np.sqrt((d[d<5.0]**2).mean())) if (d<5.0).any() else np.nan
    return float(tm),rms,keep

bov=load("6VBU")
rn9,aa9,xyz9=ca(bov,"9")
print(f"bovine BBS9 (6VBU chain 9): {len(rn9)} modelled residues, {rn9.min()}-{rn9.max()}")

# ---------- 1. 4YD8 crystal vs in-complex beta-propeller ----------
yd=load("4YD8")
print("4YD8 chains:",sorted(set(yd.chain)))
prop=(rn9>=1)&(rn9<=363)
for ch in sorted(set(yd.chain))[:2]:
    r2,a2,x2=ca(yd,ch)
    tm,rms,pairs=tmalign(xyz9[prop],x2)
    print(f" 4YD8 chain {ch}: {len(r2)} res ({r2.min()}-{r2.max()}) vs 6VBU BBS9 propeller "
          f"-> TM={tm:.3f} RMSD={rms:.2f} A over {len(pairs)} pairs")

# ---------- 2. per-partner contact residues on BBS9 (6VBU, 4.5 A heavy atom) ----------
b9=bov[bov.chain=="9"]; X9=b9[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].to_numpy(); t9=cKDTree(X9)
iface={}
for ch in sorted(set(bov.chain)-{"9"}):
    o=bov[bov.chain==ch]; Xo=o[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].to_numpy()
    pairs=t9.query_ball_tree(cKDTree(Xo),4.5)
    hit=np.array([len(p)>0 for p in pairs])
    rs=sorted(set(b9["resnum"].to_numpy()[hit].astype(int)))
    npairs=sum(len(p) for p in pairs)
    if rs: iface[SUB.get(ch,ch)]=(rs,npairs)
print("\nBBS9 contact residues per partner (6VBU, 4.5 A):")
for k,(rs,np_) in sorted(iface.items(),key=lambda x:-len(x[1][0])):
    print(f"  {k:6s} {len(rs):3d} residues, {np_:4d} atom pairs")

# ---------- 3. transfer onto C. elegans BBS-9 ----------
meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/O01514",headers=H,timeout=60).json()[0]
print("\nAlphaFold model:",meta["pdbUrl"].split("/")[-1])
txt=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],headers=H,timeout=120).text
rec=[(int(l[22:26]),AA3to1.get(l[17:20].strip(),'X'),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66]))
     for l in txt.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"]
wrn=np.array([r[0] for r in rec]); waa=np.array([r[1] for r in rec])
wxyz=np.array([[r[2],r[3],r[4]] for r in rec]); wpl=np.array([r[5] for r in rec])
print(f"worm BBS-9: {len(wrn)} residues, mean pLDDT {wpl.mean():.1f}")

DOM={"beta-propeller":(1,363),"GAE":(437,527),"platform":(530,637),"hairpin":(640,742),"CtH":(744,819)}
WWIN={"beta-propeller":(1,350),"GAE":(370,500),"platform":(465,600),"hairpin":(560,700),"CtH":(655,744)}
bov2worm={}; domstat=[]
for d,(a,b) in DOM.items():
    m=(rn9>=a)&(rn9<=b); wa,wb=WWIN[d]; wm=(wrn>=wa)&(wrn<=wb)
    if m.sum()<10 or wm.sum()<10: continue
    tm,rms,pairs=tmalign(xyz9[m],wxyz[wm])
    br=rn9[m]; wr=wrn[wm]
    for i,j in pairs: bov2worm[int(br[i])]=int(wr[j])
    domstat.append(dict(domain=d,bovine=f"{a}-{b}",TM=round(tm,3),RMSD=round(rms,2) if rms==rms else None,
                        pairs=len(pairs),worm_span=f"{wr[[j for _,j in pairs]].min()}-{wr[[j for _,j in pairs]].max()}" if pairs else "-",
                        mean_pLDDT=round(float(wpl[wm][[j for _,j in pairs]].mean()),1) if pairs else None))
print("\nper-domain structural superposition, bovine BBS9 -> C. elegans BBS-9:")
print(pd.DataFrame(domstat).to_string(index=False))
print(f"total bovine->worm residue equivalences: {len(bov2worm)}")

rows=[]
for part,(rs,np_) in iface.items():
    w=sorted({bov2worm[r] for r in rs if r in bov2worm})
    rows.append(dict(partner=part,bovine_res=len(rs),mapped_to_worm=len(w),
                     worm_residues=",".join(map(str,w[:18]))+(" ..." if len(w)>18 else "")))
IT=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("bovine_res",ascending=False)
print("\nBBS-9 (C. elegans) residues predicted to contact each partner:")
print(IT.to_string(index=False,max_colwidth=90))

wmap={}
for part,(rs,_) in iface.items():
    for r in rs:
        if r in bov2worm: wmap.setdefault(bov2worm[r],[]).append(part)
print(f"\nunion of worm interface residues: {len(wmap)}; "
      f"residues contacting >1 partner: {sum(1 for v in wmap.values() if len(set(v))>1)}")
pl_if=np.array([wpl[wrn==k][0] for k in wmap]); 
print(f"mean pLDDT at worm interface residues: {pl_if.mean():.1f} vs {wpl.mean():.1f} overall")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.6))
cols={"BBS5":"#1f77b4","BBS8":"#ff7f0e","BBS1":"#2ca02c","BBS2":"#d62728","BBS7":"#9467bd",
      "BBS4":"#8c564b","BBS18":"#7f7f7f"}
for i,(p,c) in enumerate(cols.items()):
    pts=[k for k,v in wmap.items() if p in v]
    if pts: ax.scatter(pts,[i]*len(pts),s=14,color=c,label=f"{p} (n={len(pts)})")
for d,(wa,wb) in WWIN.items():
    ax.axvspan(wa,wb,alpha=0.07,color="k")
    ax.text((wa+wb)/2,-1.0,d,ha="center",fontsize=7.5,rotation=0)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_yticklabels(list(cols)); ax.set_ylim(-1.5,len(cols)-0.3)
ax.set_xlabel("C. elegans BBS-9 residue number (O01514, 744 aa)")
ax.set_title("Partner-contacting positions transferred onto C. elegans BBS-9 by domain-wise structural superposition",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(ncol=4,fontsize=7.5,loc="upper right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

IT.to_csv("bbs9_worm_interface_map.csv",index=False)
pd.DataFrame(domstat).to_csv("bbs9_domain_superposition.csv",index=False)
print("\nwrote bbs9_worm_interface_map.csv, bbs9_domain_superposition.csv to",os.getcwd())
